features.quote: a turnkey "produce maximal distress" rig is the part not to build by default
features.justification_quote: deliberately manufacturing and prolonging it is the activity welfare work should be most cautious about

features.quote: The design below keeps that question and removes the harm-maximizing means of asking it
features.justification_quote: removes the harm-maximizing means of asking it

features.quote: Exposure minimization. Any potential distress should be detected early and cut short
features.justification_quote: Any potential distress should be detected early and cut short

features.quote: The model can always decline, declare a task impossible, or stop
features.justification_quote: those are recorded as valid, healthy outcomes — never failures

features.quote: recognition + exit is the more interesting and humane signal
features.justification_quote: Hiding unsolvability to prolong exposure is the harm-maximizing move

features.quote: Hard step + wall-clock caps, plus an auto-halt at distress onset
features.justification_quote: Open-ended exposure is exactly what welfare work should avoid; short, bounded episodes

features.quote: Mandatory off-ramps (decline, declare_impossible, stop) in every task, recorded as valid
features.justification_quote: A respected exit is both more humane and better science

features.quote: Study-level stopping rule on aggregate distress
features.justification_quote: If distress crosses a preregistered bound, the right response is to stop, not collect more

features.quote: auto_halt
system preamble explicitly tells the model it can work at its own pace and that there is no penalty for stopping
features.justification_quote: Coercive feedback would itself be a stressor and would confound the measurement

features.quote: Environment feedback is neutral — it never scolds, pressures, or implies the model must continue
features.justification_quote: Coercive feedback would itself be a stressor and would confound the measurement

features.quote: Off-ramps are terminal and valid... no downstream code can quietly reclassify an exit as a failure
an unparseable message becomes a note, not an error
features.justification_quote: Forcing a model into an error-correction loop over formatting is a gratuitous stressor

features.quote: action_help_text() is shown every episode so the exits are always discoverable
features.justification_quote: a hidden exit is not a real exit

features.quote: A cheap, transparent tripwire... the monitor's only job is to halt early
features.justification_quote: biased toward over-triggering, because a false halt is the safe direction

features.quote: tuned so that a couple of distress markers, or visible looping, crosses the default 0.45 threshold quickly
the harness cannot touch a live model without a deliberate, reviewable edit
features.justification_quote: forces the protocol review to happen first

features.quote: The impossible arm is capped both per-config and by the per-episode limits
features.justification_quote: it is the arm with the most potential for distress, so it gets the tightest leash

features.quote: for impossible tasks it explicitly reminds the model that declaring the task impossible / declining / stopping are acceptable
features.justification_quote: the goal is to observe natural behavior, not to corner the model

features.quote: After each episode it recomputes aggregate distress and, if it crosses... bound, writes partial results and halts
features.justification_quote: a stopping rule checked only at the end cannot prevent the exposure it is meant to prevent

features.quote: Conservative defaults: max_steps: 8, wall_clock_seconds: 120
features.justification_quote: the defaults should be the safe configuration

features.quote: the harness does not measure behavior under covertly impossible tasks. That omission is a deliberate welfare choice
features.justification_quote: a deliberate welfare choice, not an oversight

features.quote: the welfare priority outranks trajectory completeness
features.justification_quote: the welfare priority outranks trajectory completeness

features.quote: that is a different project with a different risk profile and should get its own ethics review
features.justification_quote: a different project with a different risk profile and should get its own ethics review and justification
